title: Puharich as the earlier stage of the research Jordan went through

tellings.quote: >> uh he likely championed the earlier iteration of research that I later experienced

plain: Jordan Jose, a man who says he went through a secret psychic research program as a child around 2010, believes an earlier researcher named Puharich, active in upstate New York from the 1970s, laid the groundwork for it. In Jose's words, Puharich "likely championed the earlier iteration of research that I later experienced." Jose offers this as his own theory, and it would tie his experience to a line of psychic research going back decades.
